description: Length of the Road Network, Borough and Region is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Road lengths in miles, by road class for each local authority and region of Great Britain since 2005. Includes, Motorways, Trunk roads, Principal roads, and Minor roads - both Rural and Urban. Using the National Roads Database from the Department for Transport (DFT). Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
